snippet.title: left 4K dead
snippet.description:
WATCH IN HD AND FULL SCREEN WHERE POSSIBLE

Playing a very small game called LEFT 4k DEAD which is only 4Kb in download size. Hence the name.

The game was created by Markus Persson (Notch; The creator of Minecraft) in a Java competition where contestants had to create a game under 4kb in size. This is the reason for the poor graphics and lack of in game sound.

I had quite a bit of fun playing this game, it really surprised me how much of a time burner it is.

Link to play: http://www.mojang.com/notch/j4k/l4kd/ 


ANY COMPUTER CAN RUN THIS!!
